description: List every trust tier with its score threshold and what it unlocks — platform commission, search boost and pricing premium. Use when a provider asks what a higher tier is worth or what it takes to reach one, and pair it with get_my_reputation to say how far away they are. The numbers come from the live scoring engine rather than documentation, so quote what this returns instead of any figure you remember. Read-only and free.
name: get_trust_tiers
